programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Headed by elite pilots, a special operations team is tasked to test new fighter jets. During test flights, the pilots face different difficulties and challenges, and try to push beyond their limits.

programme.title: The Lady Iron Chef
programme.desc: In order to win her future mother-in-law's approval, Ceci must be crowned in a gourmet cooking competition. However, there's a catch; Ceci is terrible at cooking.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: We Girls
programme.desc: Gao is in prison as she steals to buy a cochlear implant for her daughter. She befriends 3 women there and upon release, they stand together to defy fate and support each other in life's challenges.

programme.title: Far Far Away
programme.desc: A computer geek who has only been in love once suddenly & surprisingly finds himself getting romantically involved with five different women. Will he find \"the-one\"?

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: In this sequel to THE BULLET VANISHES, Sean Lau plays an inspector who is lead down a rabbit hole of discovery as he investigates a prison escape.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Someday or One Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a TV series, the movie follows Huang as she mourns for her boyfriend's death and receives a mysterious cassette player to travel back in time. Will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional racer falls into despair after causing his brother's death. He meets Dr. Hui & becomes an ambulance driver. Meanwhile, his friends uncover the truth behind his brother's accident.

programme.title: Crypto Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market.

programme.title: Let's Get Rich
programme.desc: The Jia family, a group of talented Taiwanese con artists, is recruited by a fraudster to expose a corrupt tech tycoon's Ponzi scheme and to steal millions from him through a complex deception plan.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on a string of real robberies and murder cases, a detective engages in a mouse-and-cat game with the 'Eagle Gang', a group of sophisticated, well-trained and ruthless robbers.

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Starring Andy Lau, Louis Koo, Lau Ching-Wan & Gigi Leung, this fluffy escapade features big stars, rib-tickling comedy, and loads and loads of mahjong!

programme.title: The Way We Talk
programme.desc: Three deaf youths—Wolf, Sophie and Alan—develop a profound bond and support each other through sign language. United by love and friendship, they embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Happy Dragons
programme.desc: Four retired secret agents embark on a quest for the 'Golden Relic' which turns back time and restores their youth. As they strive to rectify past mistakes, they unravel a hidden conspiracy.

programme.title: The Unwavering Brotherhood
programme.desc: Hua, Fei and Guo are robbed when transporting gang money. When Hua discovers that Fei and Guo are connected to the robbery, he must choose between loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Chow Yun Fat returns as the God of Gamblers, whose retirement plans go up in smoke when his protege seeks his help in apprehending a mastermind.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny, a housewife skilled in mahjong, loses to Curvy on the mahjong table and in vying for her husband's love. With the help from her master, Fanny challenges Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: To make a living, Teddy accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. His career regains momentum after reunites with his long-lost daughter.

programme.title: The Silent War
programme.desc: After the establishment of the People's Republic of China, blind piano tuner He Bing is recruited for his exceptional hearing with the mission to find the transmission signals of the rebel forces.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2
programme.desc: Set as a prequel, when the sun was found to be dying, humans build enormous engines on the Earth's surface to find a new home. To save the world, a group of young people decide to step forth.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: Musician Su reunites with his first love Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: Three brothers reside in a home inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother insists on dinner together every night, but tensions rises when their girlfriends join the table.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants
programme.desc: Amidst internal conflicts among martial arts sects, Guo Jing and Huang Rong unite the warriors of the Central Plains to defend Xiangyang, exemplifying courage and loyalty in the fight for the nation.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young son's death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship?

programme.title: Ready o/r Rot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi face pre-marital strife. Meanwhile, Grey Bear doubts his wife's fidelity and Ken faces a life crisis following his girlfriend's pregnancy. Can they resolve their relationship issues?

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescues the six major sects & the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues. After several vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the 2 legendary weapons.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy Without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen fakes a pregnancy to keep her job when she finds out that she is about to be fired. She begins to feel guilty about her lie when she receives much care from her colleagues.

programme.title: Blooms of Happiness
programme.desc: A store owner's family getaway spirals into chaos when his mother discovers his plan to divorce and suffers a serious car accident. Now, he has a chance to rewind time and make things right.

programme.title: Legends of the Condor Heroes: The Gallants

programme.title: RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.

programme.title: SALAM SANTAI
programme.desc: Assalamualaikum...Mulakan hari anda dengan SALAMfm-Salam Untuk Semua. Kami temani malam anda dengan segmen Salam Santai bermula pukul 12.00 tengah malam hingga 4 pagi dengan pelbagai pengisian program Islamik menarik dan hiburan yang mendidik jiwa.

programme.title: INTERAKSI 2026
programme.desc: Jom sertai program santai yang memberi peluang pendengar untuk berinteraksi bersama DJ menerusi topik-topik Islamik yang berbeza setiap minggu.

programme.title: KELUARGA USTAZ AQIL 2026
programme.desc: Drama berunsur Islamik yang menampilkan Ustaz Aqil dibintangi Ustaz PU Rahmat sebagai watak utama dan dj-dj SALAMfm sebagai pelakon tambahan tentunya akan menarik halwa telinga anda. Nantikan istimewa hanya di SALAMfm.

programme.title: TAMADUN ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Kami kongsikan kepada anda perincian mengenai kisah Sirah dan tokoh-tokoh Islam terkemuka serta tidak ketinggalan kisah keagungan peradaban Islam.

programme.title: HARI INI DALAM SEJARAH (HIDS)
programme.desc: Setiap hari ada sejarah yang tercipta...ikuti apakah peristiwa yang berlaku setiap hari dalam HIDS.

programme.title: KAK BEDAH TUDUNG BAWAL 2026
programme.desc: Celoteh Islamik berunsur nasihat yang ringkas namun padat ini mengandungi nasihat keagamaan disampaikan Kak Bedah yang sinonim dengan pemakaian tudung bawal sebagai identitinya yang tersendiri. Melalui pendekatan yang bersahaja tapi penuh makna ini, diharapkan mesej Islam dapat disampaikan dengan lebih mudah difahami dan diamalkan.

programme.desc: Hayati alunan bacaan ayat-ayat suci Al-Quran setiap hari mengikut turutan juzuk dan surah dalam Al-Quran.
